invariant: The registration capacity check-and-insert is serialized: the count is read only while holding the event-row lock.
expectedTests: rejects a submission when a rival filled the last slot between findOpen and the lock

mutations.find:
await tx.lockEvent(event.id);

    const existingCount = await tx.registrations.countForEvent(event.id);
mutations.replace:
const existingCount = await tx.registrations.countForEvent(event.id);

    await tx.lockEvent(event.id);
mutations.why: Reintroduces portal blocker B5's bug shape under current interfaces: the capacity count is read BEFORE the event lock, so a rival submission landing while waiting on the lock is not seen.
